title: Common problems
summary: Quick fixes for the things that go wrong most often.

sections.heading: The server does not start
steps: Open the Logs page. The red lines tell you what went wrong.
Press Unblock DLLs on Settings, under Advanced: Windows, if the log says Windows blocked a DLL.
Press Set server folder if Coodsz Coop Server Tool found the wrong server.

sections.heading: Friends cannot join or get kicked
steps: Check they have the same mods, in the same order, and the same map.
Read Inviting friends for the router port and the firewall.

sections.heading: The server crashes
steps: Tick Restart the server if it crashes on the Dashboard, so it comes back by itself.
If the save crashes on load, the server starts once more with the deeper save fixes. Still broken? Press Stop server, then Run Rescue save on the Logs page.

sections.heading: Asking for help
steps: Press Send my logs on the left. You see every file first, then you get a short code like CR-7KQ2M.
Post only that code in the Coodsz Discord, not the log files. Your saves and your password are not in the report.
sections.tip: Streamer mode hides addresses, Steam ids and the password, so screenshots are safe to share.
